summary: Welcome to my pet daycare & enjoy amazing pet care games with little live pets.
description:
Welcome to Tizi Town - My Pet Daycare, a super fun kids game where you can take care of adorable pets and have a blast in doggy daycare! Get ready for an exciting adventure in the pet house games for kids, where you'll have the best time playing and learning with your furry friends in the pet world.

Explore the Pet house:
Step into a magical world filled with colorful rooms and friendly animals. You can wander around and discover all the amazing things waiting for you in this kids game!

Play in the Playroom:
Join the pets in the playroom for some non-stop fun! Play hide-and-seek, jump on trampolines, and even have a friendly race. It's a paw-some time guaranteed!

Create Awesome Art: Let your creativity shine in the art room. Grab your furry pals and create amazing art together. Paint, draw, and decorate to your heart's content. Who knows, you might even become a famous artist!

Go for a Walk in the Park: Take your pet for a stroll in the park and enjoy the fresh air. Explore the beautiful scenery, play catch, and meet other friendly pets along the way. It's a wag-tastic adventure!

Clean and Feed the Animals: It's time to be a responsible pet caregiver. Help clean up after the pets, give them baths, and make sure they're happy and well-fed. Your love and care will make them wag their tails with joy!

Plan a Picnic with Your Pet Friends: Get ready for a delightful picnic with your furry pals. Pack yummy treats, set up a cozy blanket, and enjoy a wonderful time together. Don't forget to share your snacks with your animal friends!

Learn New Words in the Pet Classroom: Expand your vocabulary in the pet classroom. Meet the wise teacher and learn new words while playing fun educational games. You'll become a wordsmith in no time!

Here's why your little one will like this pet daycare game:

Hours of Fun:
Tizi Town - My Pet Daycare will keep you entertained for a long time. You'll have so much fun playing with the pets and exploring in this kids game.

Touch and Discover:
You can touch and drag different things in the game and see what happens. It's exciting to find out the surprises and see how things change.

Get Creative and Smart:
The game helps you build your creativity and thinking skills. You can make art and use your imagination. It also has puzzles and games that make you think and learn.

Play and Imagine:
Tizi Town - My Pet Daycare is all about having fun and using your imagination. You can take care of virtual pets, plan picnics, go on walks, and pretend to be in different situations.

Lots of Learning and Fun:
The game is not just entertaining but also helps you learn new things. It makes your brain work and gives you a chance to be creative and have a good time.

Tizi Town - My Pet Daycare is the perfect app for kids who love animals and enjoy creative play. With its engaging activities, colorful graphics, and friendly pets, it will keep you entertained for hours. So, join the fun and let your imagination run wild in Tizi Town!

Download now and get ready for a tail-wagging adventure!
